decision: The Career Development Plan carries the six CC-13 components as drafted, is agreed by M3 and reviewed at M6, M12, M16 and M20 alongside the item 4 steering points, and is a project deliverable, D1.3, owned by FELLOW and SUPERVISOR.
why: CC-13 makes the plan mandatory and requires it as a deliverable submitted at the start of the action. The draft assembles none of this: §1.3 lists competences, §1.4 states the intended progression, §2.1 lists what the fellowship adds, and the deliverable list D1.1-D5.5 has no entry for the plan. Without D1.3 no KPI can trace to it and §3.1 will not show it.
